page.title: Body
page.lead: A mind that studies well lives in a body that moves. Plan your week, log each session, and let the numbers tell you when to add weight.

firstRun.body: Two or three short sessions a week are enough to begin, and the targets work themselves out from what you log.

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

today.title: Today, {{day}}
today.open: {{name}} is in progress: {{done}} sets done so far.
today.trained: Trained today. Rest well, and study well.
today.rest: Nothing planned today. A rest day is part of the plan; a walk still counts.

weight.title: Body weight
weight.needTwo: Two weigh-ins on different days draw the line.

advice.first: Nothing logged yet: this session sets the baseline.
advice.hold: Missed reps last time: the same weight again ({{left}} more tries before a deload).
advice.deload: Short {{stalls}} sessions in a row: back to {{weight}} {{unit}}, and build up again.
advice.rangeUp: Top of the range in every set: {{step}} {{unit}} more, back to {{reps}} reps.
advice.rangeHold: Same weight: aim for {{reps}} reps a set this time.
advice.bodyweightUp: Your own body weight, every rep last time: go for {{reps}}.
advice.bodyweightHold: Your own body weight: the same target until every set is clean.
advice.timeUp: Held every set for the full time: {{step}} seconds more.
advice.timeHold: Came up short last time: the same hold again.
advice.timeDeload: Short {{stalls}} sessions in a row: back to {{sec}} seconds.

policy.linear: Linear: every rep, then more weight
policy.double: Double: climb the rep range, then more weight

workout.lead: {{done}} of {{total}} sets done. Tick a set when it is done; the rest timer starts on its own.
workout.finishedLead: Finished on {{day}}. You can still correct a set: the next target is worked out from what is here.
workout.add: Add an exercise to this session
workout.discardConfirm: Discard this session? Nothing of it is kept.
workout.deleteConfirm: Delete this session from your history?

finished.title: Workout done
finished.noRecords: No new best this time. Showing up is what moves it.
finished.record: New best on {{name}}: an estimated {{e1rm}} {{unit}} one-rep max, from {{weight}} {{unit}} × {{reps}}.
finished.study: Regular exercise supports focus and memory. Now is a good moment for today's review.

plan.title: Training plan
plan.lead: Your routines, and which day trains which. Targets move on their own as you log: the progression rule says why each time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitNote: Changing the unit converts every weight you have logged, so 100 kg becomes 220.5 lb rather than 100 lb.

routine.lead: One training day: its exercises in order, how each is logged and its target.
routine.name: Name
routine.progNote: Linear adds weight when every rep of every set was done; double first climbs from the lower rep target to the upper one. Three missed sessions in a row bring the weight back down about 10 %.
routine.empty: No exercises yet: search below to add one.
routine.deleteConfirm: Delete this routine? Its days become rest days; past sessions keep its name.

progress.title: Training progress
progress.lead: A year at a glance, your weight against your goal, each lift's strength, and where the work went.

heatmap.title: The year
heatmap.label: {{count}} day trained in the last year
heatmap.label_other: {{count}} days trained in the last year

lifts.title: Strength
lifts.lead: An estimated one-rep max from your best set of each session (Epley). Sets above 12 reps are not counted: they say more about endurance than strength.
lifts.chartLabel: {{name}}: the estimated one-rep max over {{count}} sessions.
lifts.none: Log a few weighted sets to see your strength over time.

coverage.title: Where the work went
coverage.allTrained: Every muscle group got some work in the last 30 days.
coverage.idle: No sets in the last 30 days: {{list}}.

coach.title: Training coach
coach.lead: A plan drafted for you, and revised from what you actually log. Nothing changes until you accept it, and an accepted change can be undone.
coach.privacy: The coach runs on the model you route for Chat. It sends your plan, your logged sets of the last eight weeks, your weigh-ins and your answers below; never your name, your email or anything else in AnyLearn.
coach.noProvider: No model is set up for Chat yet. Connect one in Settings, then come back.
coach.failed: Your model's answer did not fit the exercise library, twice. Try again, or route Chat to another model.
coach.thinking: The coach is working on it. This can take a minute.
coach.refineExample: No squats, my knee is sore. Mondays are short.
coach.draftLead: A few answers, and the coach writes a full week from the library. It leaves the weights out: your first session sets them.
coach.reviewLead: The coach reads your last eight weeks: lifts that stalled, days that never happen, muscle groups left out. It proposes changes only when the log says so.
coach.reviewNeedsPlan: Make or accept a plan first.

intake.equipmentNote: Leave all unticked for a full gym. Body-weight exercises are always included.
intake.limitations: Injuries or limits the coach should respect (optional)

library.title: Exercise library
library.lead: 1,324 exercises, each with its target muscle and how to do it.
library.credit: Exercise names and instructions: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset (MIT), in English. The dataset's images are © Gym visual and are not shown here. Body's progression rules follow openGym by Duarte Santos.

home.title: Body today
home.lowDay: A low day: ten minutes of easy movement is enough. A walk counts.
home.rest: A rest day. A short walk still helps today's studying.
home.noPlan: Regular exercise supports focus and memory. Two or three short sessions a week are enough to start.
